# Restructure Checklist: Repository Layout Cleanup

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "depth" defined unambiguously (what is counted, from where)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002, §FR-003]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK012 Are requirements defined for the generated TypeScript bindings location and the drift check after the move? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Are ignore lists (VCS, formatter, linter) required to cover every generated folder at its new location? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

- [x] CHK015 Is a recovery path defined if the move leaves the branch unbuildable? [Recovery, Gap]

## Non-Functional & Dependencies
